verdict: Leads held steady, but cost per lead rose and heating season is late.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 17 leads at a cost of $98.90 each — volume was flat while cost per lead climbed 19% as Google Ads spend accelerated sharply. The heating season campaigns that were due to launch October 1st are not yet live, which means you're entering your highest-demand window without the full ad setup in place. Separately, your Google Business Profile activity dropped 56% in the most recent week, pointing to softening local organic visibility that needs to be addressed before it compounds. On the pipeline side, lead follow-up speed is being reviewed — a burst of leads in early October did not produce confirmed contact, and that gap is being closed. Getting the heating campaigns live and tightening lead response are the two actions in motion right now; both should move the numbers in the next reporting period.
